Etymology tree
Arabic قِشْدَة (qišda)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic قشدي
From قِشْدَة (qišda, “ream, cream”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).

g: to skim, to take off the cream
